warnings: Second-floor lighting plan, same lettered-group convention as EE-03.
*** THE HOME RUN IS TAGGED 2/CU AGAINST THE GROUND FLOOR'S 1/CU, WHICH SETTLES THE CIRCUIT SPLIT: EE-02's two lighting ways F1 and F2 are one per floor. *** Neither sheet says so in words.

Group letters restart at 'a' on this floor, so a letter does NOT identify a circuit across the building -- 'a' downstairs is the exterior wall lights, 'a' upstairs is the balcony. Do not merge the two sheets' groups.
The stair is lit from both floors (group j downstairs, groups g/h up here), which is the two-way switching EE-01's สวิตซ์ 3 ทาง entry provides for.

Same caveat as EE-03: luminaire counts are read off the drawn symbols because THERE IS NO LIGHTING SCHEDULE ANYWHERE in the electrical set. RE-COUNTED AT HIGH ZOOM 2026-07-28 with the same systematic reversal as EE-03 (solid switch dots had been counted as fittings, and the d row was mis-roomed): a=2, e=2 (แต่งตัว), b+c+d=6 (ห้องนอน 3), ห้องน้ำ=2, g+h=3, j+k=4 -- TOTAL 19 fittings on this floor (29 on floor 1, so 48 in the house).
Everything east of grid 3 is roof, hatched and unlit, consistent with A-06 and SN-05.
